name: qlar-connector
description: QLAR WhatsApp connector — runs on user's machine, bridges Baileys to Messenger-BE via SignalR

scripts.build:exe:dev: npm run bundle:dev && pkg dist-bundle/index.cjs --targets node22-win-x64,node22-linux-x64,node22-macos-x64 --output bin/dev/qlar-connector
scripts.build:exe:prod: npm run bundle:prod && pkg dist-bundle/index.cjs --targets node22-win-x64,node22-linux-x64,node22-macos-x64 --output bin/prod/qlar-connector
